connector.name: Multi-MCP
connector.registryDescription: Multi-model AI orchestration MCP server with code review, compare, and debate tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package multi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the religa account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for GPT models (optional - at least one provider required)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for Claude models (optional - at least one provider required)

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google API key for Gemini models (optional - at least one provider required)

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key for additional models (optional)

env.name: DEFAULT_MODEL
env.description: Default model to use (defaults to gpt-5-mini)

env.name: DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST
env.description: Default models for multi-model comparison (comma-separated, defaults to gpt-5-mini,gemini-3-flash)
